item.title: Open Semester 2026/2027
item.description: The application procedure for enrolment in the Open Semester for the 2026/2027 academic year on the unimi.it portal will open on 15 July 2026 at 2:00 p.m.%0A%0A▶️ Learn more on Unimi.it

item.title: Call for the English language development course in view of the B2 First (FCE) exam - SOLD OUT
item.description: Registration is open for the English language development course with a view to sitting the Cambridge B2 First (FCE) exam. item.title: VISA applicants language proficiency
item.description: In accordance with ministerial guidelines, visa applicants are required to demonstrate a B2 level of proficiency in either Italian or English in order to obtain a study visa. The required language must correspond to the language of instruction of the degree programme.%0A
